annotations.title: Chinese zodiac by birth date (Lichun vs Lunar New Year)

description: Returns the Chinese zodiac animal and year pillar for a birth date under both rules in use: the BaZi rule, where the year changes at Lichun (the start of spring, around February 4), and the Lunar New Year rule used by most zodiac sites and calendars. For births in January and early February the two often disagree; the result says whether they do, gives the exact Lichun moment and the Lunar New Year date for that year, and explains the difference. Also returns the day master for the same date (the day pillar, which BaZi reads as the person). Birth time and time zone are optional and matter only for a birth on Lichun day itself; without them the result gives both possible answers. Deterministic calendar facts, 1900–2100.

hour.description: Birth hour, 24-hour clock (optional; only decides a birth on Lichun day)

lang.description: Language of the rendered output — pass the language the user is conversing in. Defaults to 'en'.

minute.description: Birth minute (optional; 0 if only the hour is given)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. 'America/New_York' (optional; Beijing time if omitted)

name: chinese_zodiac

dayMaster.description: Day master from the same date (the day pillar), which BaZi reads as the person; the zodiac animal is the year

differ.description: True when the two rules give different years for this birth

lichunYear.description: By the BaZi rule (Lichun). Null when born on Lichun day with no time given — see ifBeforeLichun / ifAfterLichun

lunarNewYear.description: By the Lunar New Year rule

springFestival.description: Lunar New Year date that year (China calendar)

title: Chinese zodiac by birth date (Lichun vs Lunar New Year)
